summary: Rules, build and tests updated first (new energy-distribution rule, CLAP margin is now a hint). Then the six engines, the drive chains, the five weapons and the shared rattle helper were reworked so that the weight lies between 100 and 400 Hz. The last full build of all 64 synth sounds passes with no hard failures; 15 sounds carry the clap-margin hint. The describing model still hears music in the cruise drive and a dog in the pulse weapon.
changed: rules.py / build.py: new rules structure-mid-share (125 Hz to 1 kHz at least 0.35, fold_jump and fold_tunnel_loop 0.20) and structure-sub-share (below 60 Hz at most 0.25, those two 0.40). CLAP margin now goes to checks.hints, pass follows checks.failed only, exit code follows hard rules. build also records checks.midShare and checks.subShare and prints them. 3 new tests, 18 tests pass.

hull.rattles (shared, signature unchanged): was a pool of identical pitched pings; now a pool of runs of 5 to 15 knocks of band noise (2 to 9 ms, soft 1.2 ms edge, low-passed at 3.8 kHz) at uneven, shrinking gaps, every run with its own pitch region and levels; weaker activity is still a subset of stronger. per_second now means runs per second. Spectrogram of engine_main_boost shows the runs as short vertical bursts between 1 and 5 kHz, bunched at uneven times (0.2, 0.8-1.0, 1.7-2.0, 4.3, 6.1, 7.3, 7.8 s), nothing above 6 kHz.

engines: hull modes weighted to 118-334 Hz (37 and 53 Hz nearly dropped), pump and reactor only as upper partials (2 to 6 times 47 Hz and 2 to 5 times 71 Hz) with 3 times more flutter and an irregular slow level wobble, steady sine modulation replaced by two bands of noise-driven wander, more noise-driven hull at idle, high-pass at 70 Hz, low-pass 680 Hz, rattles 4 times quieter and fewer. Shares: mid 0.45 to 0.72, below 60 Hz 0.00, centroid 132 to 216 Hz (was 62 to 68 Hz). Same seeds at all six settings; centroids 132 to 164 Hz from t025 to boost, idle is brighter (216 Hz) because less hull rings there.

cruise_loop: partials moved to 106, 142, 213, 285 Hz plus a trace of 71 Hz, pink noise through the upper modes; the 520 Hz line is now a faint band (tone with slow pitch swing plus narrow noise, 13 dB under where the charge leaves it) that wanders in pitch and level. Spectrogram shows a smudged faint band at 520 Hz instead of a ruler line. mid 0.49, below 60 Hz 0.00, centroid 143 Hz (was 60 Hz).

cruise_charge / engage / disengage: same upper-mode weighting, high-pass; engage starts with the pure 520 Hz line in the charge's phase and level swing, crossfades over 1.3 s to the loop's wandering band (sinks about 11 to 13 dB); whump and thud raised to 150 to 260 Hz thumps with upper-mode ring. mid 0.56, 0.61, 0.36. Calibrated one-shot peak levels re-derived with calibrate() so the drone inside each one-shot still matches the loop: charge -11.1, engage -4.3, disengage -10.1, fold_exit -11.8 dBFS (loop and fold_jump targets unchanged).

fold_tunnel_loop: tones now a trace of 37/53 Hz under a stack at 118 to 211 Hz, pink pressure noise, creaks at 0.7, 2.35 and 5.9 s (gaps 1.65, 3.55 and 1.8 s, were 2.2/2.3/2.5), creak level 0.30. mid 0.47, below 60 Hz 0.05 (was 0.94 below 60 Hz).

fold_charge, fold_jump, fold_exit: low stacks moved to 118 to 211 Hz, thumps and rings through the upper modes. mid 0.64, 0.30, 0.40. fold_charge start level raised a little so that it still starts within 5 ms.

weapon_pulse_fire rewritten after the intent: 20 ms snap of band noise 300 Hz to 1.5 kHz through the upper hull modes, then an 80 ms rough buzz on 120 Hz with harmonics to 960 Hz (noise-driven roughness, weak fundamental). mid 0.43, below 60 Hz 0.00, centroid 139 Hz (was 110 Hz, all below 100 Hz).

weapon_cannon_fire (mid 0.71), weapon_beam_loop (hum now 150 Hz with wandering level, partials 3 to 5 of 59 Hz, noise bed; mid 0.98), mining_laser_loop (hum 180 Hz, noise bed, pulse depth 0.15 so the swing stays under 6 dB; mid 0.95), missile_launch (mid 0.37): all through upper modes, high-pass, quieter fewer rattles.
verified: unittest discover: 18 tests OK (ran in this session)
Full build of all 64 synth sounds with CLAP and --describe: no hard failures, manifest validates, exit code 0 (log in assets/audio/cache/engines-agent-build.log)

Shares measured per sound: all my structure sounds pass the new rule and the old ones (85 % below 500 Hz, 2 % above 4 kHz); lowest margins: fold_jump mid 0.30 (needs 0.20), cruise_disengage mid 0.36 and missile_launch 0.37 (need 0.35), pulse below-500 share 0.956
Spectrograms looked at: engine_main_t075, engine_main_boost (before and after the rattle fix), cruise_engage, cruise_loop (before and after whine change), weapon_pulse_fire, fold_tunnel_loop

Describing model before (first set, engines only) and after: t000 fan motor -> air conditioning in a car; t025 fan motor -> air conditioning in a car; t050 motorboat idling -> engine idling; t075 car engine idling -> engine idling; t100 electronic ambient music -> engine idling; boost simple repeating three-note melody -> electronic device with a low-quality noisy mono recording. Drive and weapons had no earlier answer. After: cruise_charge ambient piece with synthesizer and guitar; cruise_engage keyboard playing a note; cruise_loop electronic organ long note; cruise_disengage electric guitar chord; fold_charge engine humming; fold_jump bass guitar slap; fold_tunnel_loop engine humming; fold_exit bell-like instrument; pulse a dog barking; cannon distorted guitar; beam a sine wave; mining laser music in the background; missile explosion.
notVerified: Nothing was heard; all judgement is from numbers, spectrograms and the describing model.
Engine crossfade between settings was judged by shares and centroids only, not by listening or by rendering a crossfade; idle (centroid 216 Hz) differs most from t025 (132 Hz).
Spectrograms of cruise_charge, cruise_disengage, fold_charge, fold_jump, fold_exit, cannon, beam, mining laser and missile were not opened.
Whether the 120 Hz harmonic buzz of the pulse weapon reads as a transformer buzz or a bark.
openIssues: The describing model still hears music in the cruise drive (organ, keyboard, guitar chord, ambient piece): the partial stack at 106/142/213/285 Hz is still a set of steady lines in the spectrogram (inside a noise bed, but visible). A next step is to drive more of it by noise through the hull and let the partials drift, at the risk of the 6 dB loop swing limit (cruise_loop was at 6.4 to 6.8 dB when tones beat more).
The describing model heard a dog bark for the pulse weapon; the buzz may need less harmonic regularity or a lower level.
Several margins are thin (see verified). The mining laser loop swing is exactly at the limit unless the pulse depth stays at 0.15.
Hint clap-margin on cruise_disengage, fold_jump, fold_exit, weapon_pulse_fire, mining_laser_loop (and 10 sounds of other categories): hints only.
cat_cabin.py was not changed (cabin path, not subject to the structure rule).

The rattle helper is shared: the other agent's impact sounds changed with it (their build passed in the same full run). The scratch file scratchpad/m.py was overwritten by the other agent; mine is in scratchpad/engines_agent/.
